helpers.name: agent-desktop
helpers.does: Lets an AI tool look at the screen and click, type and read inside desktop apps.

install.label: Windows
install.note: Needs Node.js. The first run asks for permission to control apps.

helpers.name: Graphify
helpers.does: Builds a map of a project's code so the AI reads the map instead of every file. Fewer tokens per question on big projects.
forTasks: Ask questions about a big codebase

install.label: Install the program
install.note: Or: pip install graphifyy (the name has two y's).

install.label: Teach Claude Code to use it
Build the map for a project
install.note: Type this inside the AI tool, in the project folder. It uses the tool's tokens once; later questions use fewer.

helpers.name: MemPalace
helpers.does: One memory every tool can read. What you did in Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode can be found from any of them.
forTasks: Pick up work in another tool

install.label: Connect Claude Code
install.command: claude mcp add --scope user mempalace -- mempalace-mcp

helpers.name: UnSlop
helpers.does: Guard rails for AI-written code: checks each change for the usual AI mistakes before it lands.

install.label: Set it up in a project
install.note: Run inside the project folder. Needs Node.js.

helpers.name: Claude in Chrome
helpers.does: A browser extension that lets Claude Code open sites, click, fill forms and read pages in your own Chrome.
forTasks: Do things on sites you are signed in to

install.label: Add the extension
install.note: Exact link may change. Then start Claude Code with: claude --chrome

helpers.name: Codex computer use
helpers.does: Lets Codex look at the screen and operate apps on this computer.

install.label: Turn it on in the Codex app
install.note: It comes with the Codex app (plugins). It is kept in ~/.codex/config.toml as [mcp_servers.computer-use] and the computer-use plugin.

helpers.name: ffmpeg
helpers.does: Makes, cuts and converts videos and sound. AI tools can run it to make videos from pictures or clips.
forTasks: Pull sound out of a video

helpers.name: GitHub CLI (gh)
helpers.does: Lets AI tools work with GitHub from the terminal: pull requests, issues, checks.
forTasks: Check if tests passed on GitHub

helpers.name: Docker
helpers.does: Runs programs in sealed boxes, so an AI tool can start databases or servers without changing your computer.
forTasks: Run a database for a project
